name: Sharon Gray
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Sharon’s passion is to bring healing to those who have been through a traumatic/stressful experience. She can assist in supporting you to improve depression, anxiety, PTSD, complex trauma, work or relationship stressors, grief and loss, and self-esteem. Her main clinical approach is Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR) however also trained in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Dialectic Behavioural Therapy (DBT), Internal Family Systems (IFS) and Solution Focused Therapy. Areas of practice: Trauma, Anxiety, Sexual or Physical abuse, Stress reduction, Disturbing memories.
specialties: EMDR, Trauma, Anxiety, Sexual or Physical abuse, Stress reduction, Disturbing memories

name: Chloe Shale
title: Psychologist
description: She also integrates elements of Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), Schema Therapy, Internal Family Systems (IFS) and Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). – Trauma, including Adverse Experiences, and Complex PTSD – Intersection between Complex Trauma and Late Diagnosed Autism, ADHD, & AuDHD Warm, calm, and non-judgemental, Chloe creates a grounded therapeutic space where clients feel safe to explore both current challenges and longer-standing patterns they may wish to shift. Areas of practice: Addiction, Trauma, Pregnancy/Prenatal/Postpartum, Depression, Anxiety, Panic attacks, Personality disorders, Complicated grief, Sexual or Physical abuse, Performance anxiety, Stress reduction, Disturbing memories, Phobias, Womens health.
specialties: EMDR, Addiction, Trauma, Pregnancy/Prenatal/Postpartum, Depression, Anxiety, Panic attacks, Personality disorders, Complicated grief, Sexual or Physical abuse, Performance anxiety, Stress reduction, Disturbing memories, Phobias, Womens health

name: Caroline Burrows
title: Mental Health Social Worker
description: I’m an Accredited EMDR Trainer and Consultant, Mental Health Social Worker, and Psychotherapist based in Melbourne. I deliver EMDR Basic Training (Part 1 & 2) and advanced EMDR workshops across Australia. I’m often told I bring an infectious enthusiasm for EMDR therapy to my work. My training is inclusive, neurodiverse-affirming, and designed to support you to learn in a way that feels accessible, practical, and human. Areas of practice: Trauma, Depression, Anxiety, Dissociative disorders, Sexual or Physical abuse.
specialties: EMDR, Trauma, Depression, Anxiety, Dissociative disorders, Sexual or Physical abuse
